title: Another rug pull Ring finance (similar to Strong nodes )

asr.full_text: Hey guys, just wanted to talk about two rug pulls that just occurred this week. First one's gonna be Ring Finance. Sadly, this is down about 90 plus percent. It followed a copycat or fork of the strong node kind of thing where you put in your money, it was gone, and then you were supposed to get crazy money back From a node, but there was no actual node uh, it seems like the developers ran away with everyone's money and the coin has Just fallen and crashed from about 170 Dollars all the way down to 578 uh, it's really sad, but it just seems like these people are getting people in with these high APYs and then just taking out the liquidity.
